en.hubeali: H 14854 – Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al-Washa, from Muhammad Bin Al-Fazeyl, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’farasws having said that:

‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has a Rooster. Its feet are in the seventh earth, and its neck is fixed underneath the Throne, and its wings are in the atmosphere. When it is the middle of the night, or two thirds from the end of the night. Its flaps its wings and shouts: ‘Glorious, Holy is our Lord<sup>azwj</sup>, Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, the True Proven King. So there is no god other than Him<sup>azwj</sup>, the Lord<sup>azwj</sup> of the Angels and the Spirit’. Thus the Rooster flaps its wing and crows’.
